set.body: Close the remaining direct display-parity gap by rendering the identical bilateral, layered, thresholded, transformed GIFTI example through JavaFX and Three.js at the same 960x540 dimensions. Both native outputs must be compared with the shared CPU oracle under the same SurfaceVisualQaPolicy and use the same interior pick landmark. Add reusable shared fixture constants, exact JavaFX surface/face/vertex pick parity, failure-mode tests where feasible, live receipts, documentation, focused JVM/Scala.js gates, and repository-wide compile/test verification.
set.title: Surface viewer direct JavaFX-WebGL fixture parity
